scope: The 4 October supplied trial instruction supersedes the earlier unsaved/no-save-control activity rule for these new v020 tasks only. Each task proposes the verified native optional S.notes response interface, with distinct IDs and no required-progress contribution. Previous v010 and full-chapter artifacts remain unchanged.
registrationStatus: Proposal only. Separate SHA256/UTF8-bounded C.notes title registrations must be considered by the integrator; no original native/configuration file is edited.
comparisonBehavior: Hints and models are voluntary plain details disclosures. Learners are asked to save a first response before comparing, but no automatic save-to-unlock or access gate is claimed.
persistenceBoundary: Existing native draft saving, explicit collection, reload and All My Work semantics are source-read evidence. No functional save/reload/All My Work test or integration has occurred. Teacher reading HTML disables controls and includes a separate administrative notice.
